assets.name: overload
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art game sprite sheet on TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. The supplied image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY of an existing friendly mining robot, do not reproduce its drill or its exact design. Create ONE NEW friendly OVERLOAD ROBOT for the same 2D pixel cave mining game, three frames horizontally in three equal cells, identical baseline and fixed body silhouette across all frames. Compact squat charcoal steel robot, copper orange casing, two short sturdy legs, round exposed warm amber reactor at center, TWO small symmetrical electrical capacitor coils over shoulders, tiny cyan eye visor to mark friendly robot. Readable chunky 24x24-style pixel clusters, dark outline, restrained brass highlights, crisp stepped pixel shapes. No drill, no gun, no human face, no hat, no text. Three frames ONLY vary the reactor light and coil sparks: dim amber, bright amber, pale yellow pulse; the feet, hull and silhouette stay fixed. Full body centered in each equal cell, all same size, ample transparent spacing, no ground shadow, no scene, no black background, no glow extending beyond each sprite. A reusable companion, explosion does not destroy it. WIDE 3:1 sprite sheet.
